scope: First observed snapshot, not a reconstructable pre-publication state
rules: Every observation in this window must reference both prior intervention IDs for provenance; interpret results as a current-state snapshot after the MC-001 public page change. The AIO-001 methodology correction is not an entity-performance treatment.
Record the exact frozen prompt text and one full original response per system and prompt.
Record login, location if visible, browsing/search state, model/interface if visible and timestamp for each run.
Missing or blocked runs are documented explicitly; they are not counted as zero recognition.
Recommendation prompts are reported separately from direct recognition.
A one-run snapshot does not support a stability claim; add repeat-run plan before measuring stability.
Freeze the baseline only after validating observations and listing every planned missing run. Do not claim complete cross-system coverage if any planned pair is missing.
